description: This file defines a wizard for handling stock return operations in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including generating return lines, creating return pickings, and opening related views.

classes.name: wizard_return_picking
classes.description: Wizard interface class for handling stock return process with defined states.

methods.name: _get_returns
methods.description: Prepares return lines form and fields based on the selected picking.

methods.name: _create_returns
methods.description: Creates return stock pickings and moves based on user input.

methods.name: _action_open_window
methods.description: Opens the window to display the created return picking.
